system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the agent is provided with a list of available action types, guidelines for operating the phone, and a list of UI elements derived from the Android accessibility tree’s leaf nodes
system_prompt_style.note: m3a.py not in evidence; the prompt is inferred from prose to include per-step UI elements.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a list of UI elements derived from the Android accessibility tree’s leaf nodes
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the screen UI element list is injected every step. There is no repo navigation.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: This summary will serve as the action history and be used for future action selection.
context_compaction.note: Closest value: the reflection summaries replace the raw history. It could also be read as summarize.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The agent receives the current screenshot and a Set-of-Mark (SoM) (Yang et al., 2023a)
observation_format.note: The text-only variant uses only the a11y tree. The default in run configs is not shown in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: In the first stage, M3A generates an action, represented in JSON, and reasoning for that action.

tool_count.note: json_action.py is not shown. The action types are listed in random_agent.py, but that list is not a tool schema.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The action space is similar to that which humans use, consisting of gestures (i.e., tapping, swiping), typing, and navigation buttons
edit_primitive.note: This is a GUI agent and has no file-edit tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: the agent is provided with a list of available action types

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: This class provides flexibility in agent design, allowing developers to define custom action spaces and interaction methods
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A appears in the file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It is zero-shot, integrating ReAct-style (Yao et al., 2022) and Reflexion-style (Shinn et al., 2023) prompting
loop_primitives.note: Each step runs action then reflection. The loop is in episode_runner.py.

human_in_loop.note: HumanAgent replaces the agent, so it is not HITL.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: This summary will serve as the action history and be used for future action selection.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If a run fails part-way through, you can resume it by re-running the script with the `--checkpoint_dir` flag pointing to the output directory from the original run.
state_persistence.note: Resume is at suite/task level (checkpointer.py), not mid-episode.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After executing an action, M3A reflects on its effect by observing any state changes that may have occurred.

rollback.evidence_quote: AndroidWorld will automatically clear the database and all app state when `initialize_state` and/or `tear_down` are called.
rollback.note: Only harness task teardown exists; the agent has no rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: run until it determines a task is complete, if the max number of steps is reached, of if the termination_fn is True.
termination_condition.note: termination_fn (e.g. MiniWoB reward) is coded as test_pass.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: This model can be expensive. For serious usage, you can switch to a more cost-effective model, by modifying the `model_name` in the script.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It runs on a live Android emulator

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: With adb, A NDROID WORLD has complete access to system resources including the file system
filesystem_access.note: The agent acts only via UI actions inside the emulator.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Open environment with access to millions of Android apps and websites
